about: LacrosseNet output for one NLL broadcast. Positions are in feet from the centre spot: x along the floor (-100..100), y across it (-42.5..42.5). 'Attacking right' figures are mirrored so the team always attacks +x. Times are broadcast seconds; game clock where known.

definitions.distance_ft: sum of Kalman-smoothed speed x time while tracked on the floor
definitions.offensive_half_share: share of tracked time in the half the team attacks
definitions.mean_spacing_ft: mean distance between a team's tracked skaters in the same frame
definitions.mean_depth_ft: mean front-to-back spread of a team's tracked skaters
definitions.top_speed_mph: 95th percentile of smoothed speed, in mph (broadcast-tracking estimate, +-10-15%)
definitions.best_1s_speed_mph: fastest average speed over any 1-second stretch
definitions.high_speed_distance_ft: distance covered above 14 ft/s (~9.5 mph); sprint_distance_ft above 20 ft/s (~13.6 mph)
definitions.stints: identified players' sightings joined when less than 25 s apart (camera-limited, experimental)
definitions.transitions: team centroid moving from its defensive zone to its offensive zone: seconds and centroid speed
definitions.widest_seam_ft: largest lateral gap between neighbouring defenders in their own zone
definitions.slot_to_nearest_ft: distance from the slot (15 ft in front of goal) to the nearest defender
definitions.matchups: each frame, attackers are paired with defenders by optimal assignment; time and mean separation
definitions.picks: heuristic: a near-stationary attacker that a teammate brushes past, after which the teammate's defender falls 3+ ft further behind within 1 s
definitions.space_control: share of the visible floor each team would reach first (0.3 s drift + 20 ft/s)
definitions.shot_gap_ft: the open gap in the defence around the shooter at release (angular gap between the nearest defenders on either side, in feet at the shooter's distance)
definitions.nearest_defender_ft: distance from the shooter (or ball carrier) to the closest defender
definitions.defenders_in_lane: defenders within 3 ft of the line from shooter to goal
definitions.carrier_pressure: for each ball carrier: mean distance to the nearest defender and share of time within 5 ft
